name: issue-228-subclass-trade-ticker
description: Issue #228: a 401(k) holds a total-market fund (SCHB) alongside sub-class funds (VOO large cap, VO mid cap) and the target exits mid cap. SCHB covers every cap sleeve via the hierarchy, so the pre-fix resolver saw [SCHB, VO] / [SCHB, VOO] as ambiguous and emitted bare 'US Mid Cap · SELL' and 'US Large Cap · BUY' rows with no ticker. The fixed resolver prefers the single exact-class holding: the mid-cap sell executes via VO and both large-cap buys merge into one VOO buy. Only the small-cap buy (no small-cap fund held) stays ticker-less.
